import urllib.request,json,datetime
base="https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/mobile/updates/native/"
with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+"latest.json",headers={"Cache-Control":"no-cache","User-Agent":"OnTrack-Native-Update-Probe"}),timeout=9) as r:
 status=r.status;raw=r.read(16384);ct=r.headers.get("Content-Type","")
meta=json.loads(json.loads(raw)["payload"])
assert status==200 and meta["version_code"]==12 and meta["package"]=="com.ontrack.voiceproof"
with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+meta["file"],method="HEAD",headers={"User-Agent":"OnTrack-Native-Update-Probe"}),timeout=9) as r:
 apkstatus=r.status;length=int(r.headers.get("Content-Length","0"));apkctype=r.headers.get("Content-Type","")
assert apkstatus==200 and length==meta["size"]
print(json.dumps({"manifest_http":status,"version":meta["version_code"],"apk_http":apkstatus,"content_length":length,"size_matches":True,"sha256":meta["sha256"],"apk_content_type":apkctype,"checked_utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}))
